package clickhouse

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"

	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type LearningSessionSummaryRepository struct{ conn clickhouse.Conn }

func NewLearningSessionSummaryRepository(conn clickhouse.Conn) *LearningSessionSummaryRepository {
	return &LearningSessionSummaryRepository{conn: conn}
}

func (repository *LearningSessionSummaryRepository) GetLearningSessionSummary(ctx context.Context, studentID, sessionID uuid.UUID) (*domain.LearningSessionSummary, error) {
	const query = `
SELECT
  min(event_ts), max(event_ts),
  greatest(dateDiff('second', min(event_ts), max(event_ts)), 0),
  toInt64(sum(active_gap_seconds)),
  countIf(event_type = 'lesson_completed'),
  countIf(event_type = 'task_completed'),
  countIf(event_type = 'question_asked'),
  countIf(event_type = 'text_selected'),
  countIf(event_type = 'code_executed'),
  countIf(event_type IN ('compiler_error', 'test_failed')),
  countIf(event_type = 'test_passed'),
  countIf(event_type = 'hint_requested'),
  countIf(event_type = 'teacher_intervened'),
  countIf(event_type = 'student_stuck')
FROM (
  SELECT event_ts, event_type,
    greatest(least(dateDiff('second', lagInFrame(event_ts, 1, event_ts) OVER (
      ORDER BY event_ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ), event_ts), 60), 0) AS active_gap_seconds
  FROM stat_events
  WHERE user_id = ? AND session_id = ?
)
HAVING count() > 0`
	result := &domain.LearningSessionSummary{
		AnalyticsSessionID: sessionID, StudentID: studentID, PolicyVersion: "learning-analytics-active-time-v1",
	}
	var (
		wallClockSeconds      int64
		activeLearningSeconds int64
		lessonCount           uint64
		taskCount             uint64
		questionCount         uint64
		selectionCount        uint64
		codeRunCount          uint64
		failureCount          uint64
		passedTestCount       uint64
		hintCount             uint64
		interventionCount     uint64
		stuckCount            uint64
	)
	err := repository.conn.QueryRow(ctx, query, studentID, sessionID).Scan(
		&result.StartedAt, &result.LastActivityAt, &wallClockSeconds, &activeLearningSeconds,
		&lessonCount, &taskCount, &questionCount, &selectionCount, &codeRunCount, &failureCount,
		&passedTestCount, &hintCount, &interventionCount, &stuckCount,
	)
	if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result.WallClockSeconds = int(wallClockSeconds)
	result.ActiveLearningSeconds = int(activeLearningSeconds)
	result.LessonCount = int(lessonCount)
	result.TaskCount = int(taskCount)
	result.QuestionCount = int(questionCount)
	result.SelectedExplanationCount = int(selectionCount)
	result.CodeRunCount = int(codeRunCount)
	result.FailureCount = int(failureCount)
	result.PassedTestCount = int(passedTestCount)
	result.HintCount = int(hintCount)
	result.TeacherInterventionCount = int(interventionCount)
	result.StuckSignalCount = int(stuckCount)
	return result, nil
}
